behavior: In --check mode, compares the stored base logits against current logits, writes same-top1 count, first mismatch, top1/top2 token ids/pieces/logits, margins, max_abs, and mean_abs to JSON. With --top1-fail-on-mismatch, exits failure if any top1 differs.

checks.name: help parses with --top1-report stripped before common parser

next_required_validation: Run a DS4 diagnostic self-check with an accepted fixed France text under a 16GB cgroup before relying on this verifier for future GPU/offload candidates. This diagnostic cannot promote token rate.
